Layout Note
fields.options: 🗍️ Layout & Navigation  Control the portal's structural layout — sidebar width, navbar height, corner style, density, and attendance color thresholds. Changes take effect on the next page load for all parents.

fields.description: Controls which color band is shown for each student's attendance percentage
fields.label: Attendance Thresholds

fields.description: Attendance at or above this percentage is shown in Success (green) color
fields.label: Good Attendance Threshold (%)

fields.description: Attendance at or above this (but below Good threshold) is shown in Warning (amber) color. Below this is Danger (red).
fields.label: Warning Attendance Threshold (%)

fields.description: Label shown when attendance is at or above the Good threshold
fields.label: Good Attendance Label

fields.description: Label shown when attendance is between Warning and Good thresholds
fields.label: Warning Attendance Label

fields.description: Label shown when attendance is below the Warning threshold
fields.label: Danger Attendance Label

fields.description: Width: Narrow = 200px, Normal = 256px, Wide = 300px
fields.label: Sidebar Width

fields.description: Height of the top navigation bar: Compact = 50px, Normal = 62px, Tall = 74px
fields.label: Navbar Height

fields.description: Card corner style: Sharp = 6px, Normal = 16px, Pill = 24px
fields.label: Corner Style

fields.description: Compact reduces card/nav padding for a denser information display
fields.label: Layout Density

Advanced Note
fields.options: ⚠️ Advanced — Custom CSS  Inject raw CSS that is appended after all portal stylesheets. Use CSS variables like --pp-primary for theme-consistent overrides. Incorrect CSS here can break the portal layout — test changes carefully before saving.

fields.description: Controls the "Sign in with NLS Google account" option on the parent login page
fields.label: Login & Security

fields.description: Show a "Sign in with NLS Google account" button on the parent login page. Requires a Social Login Key for Google to be configured and enabled, and the Google account's email must match a Parent/Guardian Email ID on at least one child's Student Master record.
fields.label: Enable Google Login for Parents

fields.description: Only Google accounts on this domain may log in as a parent (e.g. gmail.com). Leave blank to allow any domain.
fields.label: Allowed Google Account Domain

fields.description: Inject raw CSS that is appended after all portal styles. Use this for pixel-perfect adjustments not covered by the settings above.
fields.label: Advanced — Custom CSS

fields.description: Raw CSS injected at the end of every parent portal page. Use CSS variables like --pp-primary for consistency.
fields.label: Custom CSS
